# Graphics source records

Source is reconstructed on demand with `python3 script/fetch_graphics_sources.py --state baseline` from the project root. The downloaded component trees stay ignored; the repository contains their source pins, complete local patches, and the ten-file baseline overlay record.

See [graphics.md](../../docs/graphics.md) for source reconstruction, experimental changes, historical recipes, and remaining binary-qualification limits. The MIT license for original Astra code does not relicense these third-party sources or patches.
